nodes.title: 视频长度（25帧为一秒，总帧数为25*秒数+1）

widgets_values:
**Shot 1:** Low-angle wide shot with slow dolly forward, debris-strewn urban ruins under stormy twilight sky, volumetric fog clinging to broken skyscraper skeletons, steel beams and shattered glass reflecting neon glows, Iron Man in red-and-gold armor crouched on rubble, chest plate glowing faintly, arms tensed, eyes locked on Superman, shallow depth of field blurs distant wreckage (Sound FX: Distant thunder rumble, metallic scrap grinding)

**Shot 2:** Handheld medium close-up orbits around Iron Man as he lunges forward, repulsor blasts crackle from his palms, body tensed in combat stance, eyes narrowed, jaw clenched, he shouts, **[Standard Mandarin Male Voice]:** “小子，你死定了” → Camera instantly cuts to Superman, cape billowing in wind, fists raised, stance wide and defiant, eyes blazing with resolve, he turns his head slightly, voice sharp and dismissive, **[Standard Mandarin Male Voice]:** “别做梦了手下败将。” → Camera tracks Superman’s movement as he steps back, cape flaring, fingers twitching with latent power, no eye contact, body language radiating contempt

**Shot 3:** Slow dolly-out to wide static composition, Iron Man’s repulsor beams flicker out, armor emits a low hum, he stands still, breathing shallow, shoulders slumped slightly, eyes still fixed on Superman, who now strides forward with heavy steps, cape trailing behind, fists clenched, posture shifting from arrogance to simmering fury, background rubble trembles under unseen force (Sound FX: Repulsor discharge fades, distant city sirens, faint crackle of energy discharge)
